description: This file is an HTML page for a Database Viewer web interface, providing UI layout, styles, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic database interaction.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads the list of databases from the server and updates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates cell content, including handling long text and objects, with expand feature.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses multi-line and JSON cell content.
